ValidationRule.description: 特定的Role才能選相對應的Staus
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( $UserRole.Name="System Administrator", FALSE, IF( /* 受管控的 Status|Approval 集合（任一角色） */ CONTAINS( ";In Progress|New;In Progress|In Progress;In Progress|Approved;Replied|Approved;Closed|Approved;Replied|New;Reapplied|New;Closed|New;Reapplied|In Progress;In Progress|Conditionally Approved;Replied|Conditionally Approved;Closed|Conditionally Approved;In Progress|Documents Required;Replied|Documents Required;Reapplied|Documents Required;Closed|Documents Required;In Progress|Rejected;Replied|Rejected;Closed|Rejected;Reapplied|Approved;Reapplied|Conditionally Approved;Reapplied|Rejected;", ";"&TEXT(Status__c)&"|"&TEXT(Approval_Status__c)&";" ), /* 若屬受管控組合 → 檢查 pair:RC 是否被允許 */ NOT( CONTAINS( ";" /* S1 */ &"In Progress|New:CC;"&"In Progress|New:B2B;" &"In Progress|In Progress:RMS;" &"In Progress|Approved:EHD;" &"Replied|Approved:RMS;" &"Closed|Approved:CC;"&"Closed|Approved:B2B;" /* S2 */ &"Replied|New:RMS;" &"Reapplied|New:CC;"&"Reapplied|New:B2B;" &"Closed|New:CC;"&"Closed|New:B2B;" &"Reapplied|In Progress:RMS;" &"Reapplied|Approved:EHD;"&"Reapplied|Conditionally Approved:EHD;"&"Reapplied|Rejected:EHD;" &"Replied|Approved:RMS;"&"Replied|Conditionally Approved:RMS;"&"Replied|Rejected:RMS;" &"Closed|Approved:CC;"&"Closed|Approved:B2B;" &"Closed|Conditionally Approved:CC;"&"Closed|Conditionally Approved:B2B;" &"Closed|Rejected:CC;"&"Closed|Rejected:B2B;" /* S3（再次要求補件的中繼點與終點）*/ &"In Progress|Documents Required:EHD;" &"Replied|Documents Required:RMS;" &"Reapplied|Documents Required:EHD;" &"Reapplied|Documents Required:CC;" &"Reapplied|Documents Required:B2B;" /* S4（CA 主線）*/ &"In Progress|Conditionally Approved:EHD;" &"Replied|Conditionally Approved:RMS;" &"Closed|Conditionally Approved:CC;"&"Closed|Conditionally Approved:B2B;" /* S5（DR 主線）*/ &"Replied|Documents Required:RMS;" &"Closed|Documents Required:CC;"&"Closed|Documents Required:B2B;" /* S6（Rejected 主線）*/ &"In Progress|Rejected:EHD;" &"Replied|Rejected:RMS;" &"Closed|Rejected:CC;"&"Closed|Rejected:B2B;" , ";"& TEXT(Status__c)&"|"&TEXT(Approval_Status__c)&":"& IF(CONTAINS($UserRole.Name,"CC"),"CC", IF(CONTAINS($UserRole.Name,"B2B"),"B2B", IF(CONTAINS($UserRole.Name,"RMS"),"RMS", IF(CONTAINS($UserRole.Name,"EHD"),"EHD","OTHER") ) ) ) &";" ) ), /* 非受管控組合 → 放行 */ FALSE ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 您的系統權限無法設定此組合 (Status / Approval Status)。 Your role is not allowed to set this Status / Approval Status.
